## Goals

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

- Say why a slope has a sampling distribution
- Test a slope with t and with F
- Give an interval for β
- Read a regression table

## Reading

- {{< fa book >}} The rest of section 14-6, "analysis of regression".
- {{< fa book >}} [Part 1 of our regression handout](/resource/regression-handout.qmd#part-1), on testing the slope, which goes further than the book.
- {{< fa pencil >}} Practice: Problems 1 to 3 at the end of [the handout](/resource/regression-handout.qmd#practice). Solutions are on Canvas.

::: {.callout-note}
## The book and our slides

- **The book:** uses *beta* for the standardized slope, and tests the slope only with F. **Our slides:** use β for the true slope in the population, and test it with t as well as F, with an interval for β.
:::
